significance: A Murugan temple on Sri Lanka's eastern coast whose founding is placed in the period of Chola rule over the island, with a later reconstruction in stone attributed to Manuneya Gajabahu. The sanctum is identified as Pandya work.
story: An elderly devadasi named Thangammai, dismissed from temple service, is said to have reappeared the next morning as an eight-year-old girl ready to perform the rituals.
